VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criterion requires objective verification that "all 88 tests pass," but only a self-report (SELF provenance) is provided. Without independent artifacts such as CI logs, test output, diffs, or signed attestations (SIGN), there is no way to verify the claimed test results or the actual implementation of the fix. Self-reports alone cannot satisfy acceptance criteria that demand measurable, verifiable outcomes.
